topics.topic: Actor attribution for automatic writes emitted during request-driven run advancement
questions: When `runs.start_run`, `runs.continue_after_approval`, `runs.continue_after_resolution`, or `runs.resume_run` trigger automatic node progression and write trace/run-progress records, should those writes be attributed to the request actor or to `kernel`?

topics.topic: Canonical representation of non-file outputs returned by `service_invoker.send_prepared_request` to `effects`
questions: In what exact representation are non-file output values returned to `effects` (decoded native values, canonical JSON bytes, or both)?

topics.topic: Public error contract for `store.read_records` when relation argument shape is invalid
questions: For `store.read_records`, is invalid relation argument shape part of the public error contract (returning `internal_error`), or should callers assume only `unknown_reference` is possible?

topics.topic: Standard return shape and invocation convention for `public_op:clock.monotonic_deadline` across callers
questions: What exact output shape and calling convention must this operation return so all callers (`sandbox`, `service_invoker`) use it the same way?

topics.topic: Success criteria for `release_run` when spool deletion I/O fails (synchronous delete vs deferred cleanup)
questions: Does `release_run` succeed only after physical spool deletion, or may it succeed with deletion deferred to startup cleanup?

topics.topic: `list_records` behavior for non-existent record IDs in filter fields (error vs empty result)
questions: When `list_records` filter fields are record identities (for example `run_id`, `flow_version_id`, `contract_version_id`) and the identity does not exist, must the call refuse `unknown_reference` or return an empty page?
